name: lees-components
description: Lee's Components: Sanity Studio and Next.js site for building and testing AQA page builder components, starting with the hero slider.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n studio,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w studio" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w studio && npm run build -w web
scripts.icons:check: cmp web/src/lib/menu-icons.tsx studio/components/menu-icons.tsx && echo Icon sets match
